analysis_refs.heading: Research matrix
analysis_refs.text: | **P07 Topographic, land-cover and historical maps — C19** | [USGS National Map](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/there-api-accessing-national-map-data), state/local GIS catalogs and public library map collections | Survey of India and [Bhuvan](https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/) discovery, state remote-sensing/GIS agencies and public historical-map collections | Place, sheet number, extent, date/edition or layer → actual map product/viewer/download. Distinguish present-day topography from historical sheets, satellite imagery and cadastral boundaries. |

analysis_refs.heading: Evidence status and next verification
analysis_refs.text:
Direct opens of data.gov.in timed out, DILRMP's older state-link page and NGDRS
state links returned 502 in the research tool, NGMDB returned 403, and the older
Bhuvan WMS wiki URL returned 404 despite remaining in search results. Bhuvan's
homepage exposed only a loading shell; NGDR terms could not be opened. Official
search results identified GSI/NGDR and land-directory leads, but no machine-query
or free post-login behavior is certified. Record these gaps and recheck the
operator's current documentation; do not interpret the tool failures as national
service outages or a reason to invent an endpoint.
